name: Dundalk CT Element Nook 2-Person Indoor Sauna
description: Dundalk CT Element Nook Indoor Sauna The Element Nook is a compact indoor sauna thoughtfully designed for smaller spaces, private wellness rooms, home gyms, bathrooms, and personal retreats. The Nook delivers the benefits of traditional sauna bathing while maintaining a minimal footprint and refined presence. Expertly crafted in Canada from Thermo Grandis wood, the Nook offers outstanding dimensional stability, moisture resistance, and long-lasting durability. Its contemporary full-glass front creates an open, modern aesthetic while allowing natural light to brighten the interior, making even smaller spaces feel more spacious and inviting. Designed for one to two bathers, the Nook features a thoughtfully planned interior that maximizes comfort while maintaining a compact exterior. Compatible with a 4.5 kW electric sauna heater, it delivers the authentic heat, performance, and wellness benefits expected from a traditional sauna, making it an ideal addition to any indoor wellness space. Features Proudly crafted in Canada by skilled Canadian woodworkers as part of the Canadian Timber Collection. Constructed from premium Thermo Grandis wood for exceptional durability, stability, and moisture resistance. Thermo processed in Ontario, Canada to enhance long-term performance and create a luxury-grade sauna material. Contemporary full-glass front creates an open, bright, spa-inspired appearance while showcasing the warm interior. Spacious 20" upper benches and 15" lower benches provide enhanced comfort for sitting, reclining, and relaxing. Fully framed floor system built with durable 2x4 construction and finished with a Thermo Grandis floor surface. Triple-layer wall construction with a vapor barrier and air gap for improved durability and simplified electrical wiring. Premium 10 mm tempered glass door and front window provide strength, safety, and a modern aesthetic. Designed exclusively for use with electric sauna heaters. Panelized construction allows for faster, easier, and more efficient assembly. Ideal for indoor wellness spaces including homes, bathrooms, basements, home gyms, spas, hotels, and wellness studios. Part of the Canadian Timber Collection, delivering authentic Canadian craftsmanship and premium construction quality. Soft interior lighting enhances the natural beauty of the wood while creating a warm, relaxing atmosphere. Designed to deliver an authentic traditional sauna experience that promotes relaxation, recovery, and everyday wellness. Specifications Sauna Size Element Nook Comfortably Seats 1-2 People Exterior Depth 54.75" (139 cm) Exterior Width 54.75" (139 cm) Exterior Height 88.0625" (224 cm) Interior Depth 44.75" (114 cm) Interior Width 44.75" (114 cm) Interior Height 80.5" (204 cm) Interior Volume 93 ft³ (2.6 m³) Wood Heater Available No Electric Heater Available Yes Recommended Electric Heater Size 4.5 kW Technical Nook Assembly Instructions Nook Product Drawing Regular sauna maintenance is an important aspect of owning a sauna and is essential for preserving the longevity of the sauna and ensuring a pleasant and relaxing experience. General Guidelines Use towels on benches to protect the wood and absorb sweat during sauna use. Ensure that both the air inlet and outlet vents are unobstructed to maintain proper airflow. After Each use: Ventilate the sauna: Open the door after each session to allow fresh air circulation and reduce moisture buildup. Wipe surfaces: Use a clean, dry towel to remove sweat and moisture from benches, backrests, and all wooden surfaces. Rinse with cold water: This helps close the pores of the wood and promotes faster drying.
